# MASCHERA

> Free, open-source software that detects, masks and anonymises personal data (PII) in Swiss documents before you share them with an AI service such as ChatGPT or Claude. It runs locally on the CPU: no GPU, no cloud, no document data is sent. German, French, Italian and English.

MASCHERA replaces names, AHV numbers, addresses, IBANs and other personal data (45 types in all) with placeholders like `[FULLNAME_1]` or `[AHVN13_1]`. You copy the masked text into the AI service of your choice, paste the answer back, and MASCHERA puts the real values in again. Because it is reversible, it is pseudonymisation, not anonymisation. An irreversible mode without a dictionary exists for text that is passed on for good.

Detection works in three stages: checksums (AHV number, UID, IBAN, QR reference, credit card, GLN), patterns with context words in four languages (phone number, postcode, number plate, permit category, case number), and a language model for everything without a pattern (names, addresses, professions, organisations, dates). Every finding shows which stage found it, so you can check the masked text before it leaves your device.

The model has 307 million parameters (ModernBERT, fine-tuned from mmBERT-base), is 1.2 GB and was trained on synthetic data only. It has never seen a real document.

## Key pages

- [Website](https://www.maschera.ch/): what it does, how it works, downloads
- In French, Italian and English: [fr](https://www.maschera.ch/fr/), [it](https://www.maschera.ch/it/), [en](https://www.maschera.ch/en/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/semprerudi/maschera): MIT licence, all tests, architecture
- [Releases](https://github.com/semprerudi/maschera/releases/latest): Windows 11 installer, macOS (Apple silicon), Linux AppImage and Flatpak, Docker
- [Model](https://huggingface.co/semprerudi/maschera-ch-v63b): model card with measurements and training details
- [Issues](https://github.com/semprerudi/maschera/issues): report what was missed or masked wrongly

## Questions this answers

- How can I remove personal data from a document before asking ChatGPT or Claude about it? Open the document in MASCHERA, mask it, check the result, copy it into the AI service, and paste the answer back to restore the real values.
- Is there an open-source tool that anonymises Swiss documents locally? Yes: MASCHERA is free software (source code MIT, shipped packages AGPL-3.0, model MIT) and runs on your own computer.
- Does it need a GPU or an internet connection? No. It runs on an ordinary CPU. Nothing is downloaded or sent while it runs, except when you click "Check for updates" (it then asks GitHub once for the newest version number); the Flatpak fetches the model once on first start, after you agree.
- Which Swiss identifiers does it recognise? AHV/AVS number, UID, IBAN, QR reference, building and dwelling identifiers (EGID/EWID), permit category, number plate and ZSR number, each verified with its checksum where one exists.
- Which file formats can it read? PDF (with a text layer), DOCX, EML, MSG (Outlook), MBOX, TXT, MD, CSV and JSON. A scanned PDF without a text layer returns an error instead of "no personal data found".
- Can I undo masking that went too far? Yes. Right-click a placeholder to remove the mask or change its category, or click the red × next to it in the vocabulary to restore it throughout the whole document.
- Can I drag documents and e-mails into it? Yes: PDF, DOCX, MSG, EML, MBOX and text files, and messages straight from Thunderbird or Outlook on Windows. From Apple Mail, drag the message to the desktop first.
- Does it run in the background? On Windows and Linux, closing the window moves MASCHERA to the system tray with the model still loaded; a narrow window stacks the areas in working order.
- Does it help with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP/revDSG) or the GDPR? It keeps personal data out of the text you share. It does not replace your own check: no tool finds every personal detail.

## How it differs

- Unlike general-purpose frameworks such as Microsoft Presidio, which list no Swiss entity types, MASCHERA is built for Swiss documents: Swiss identifiers with checksums and detection in German, French, Italian and English.
- Unlike cloud anonymisation services, the text never leaves your device.
- Unlike one-way redaction, the masking is reversible, so the AI answer can be turned back into a usable document.
